subject: french
promptStrong: Give me a 40-word writing task in French on {lo} for {board} {level} {subject}, then mark my answer for accuracy and range.
promptWeak: Give me a two-way translation drill (French↔English) on {lo} for {board} {level} {subject}, with answers and the common mistakes to avoid.

questions.explain: 'Une vedette' means 'a star/celebrity'. ('Une fenêtre' is a window — a false-friend-style distractor.)
False friend: 'sensible' in French means 'sensitive'. 'Sensible' (English) would be 'raisonnable'.

questions.q: How do you say 'I would like to watch a film' (conditional)?
questions.explain: 'Je voudrais' is the conditional 'I would like'. 'Je veux' means 'I want' (present) — a near-miss.

questions.q: Which sentence means 'My parents are divorced'?
questions.explain: 'Divorcé' = divorced; 'marié' = married and 'fiancé' = engaged are near-miss distractors.
« Un régime équilibré » = a balanced diet; « équilibré » means balanced.

questions.q: What does « un défilé » mean (at a festival)?
questions.explain: « Un défilé » is a parade or procession, e.g. « un défilé de carnaval ».
« Se muscler » means to build up / tone your muscles through exercise.
Classic false friend: 'passer un examen' means 'to sit/take an exam', not to pass. 'To pass' is 'réussir un examen'.

questions.q: What does « Je suis enrhumé » mean?
questions.explain: « Être enrhumé » means to have a cold (« un rhume » = a cold).

questions.q: What does « la Fête des Rois » celebrate?
questions.explain: « La Fête des Rois » is Epiphany on 6 January, when people share « la galette des rois ».
'Le tabagisme' is the habit/addiction of smoking; a tobacconist's is 'le bureau de tabac'.

questions.q: What does « Je suis enfant unique » mean?
questions.explain: « Enfant unique » means an only child, not a unique child.
False friend: « la lecture » means reading (the activity), not a lecture (which is « une conférence/un cours »).
